definition: the hard bottom at safety minus two, shared with exertion and digestion

settled:
At safety minus two both branches of my autonomic system effectively shut down, the sympathetic and the parasympathetic together.

So my heart rate will not rise with exertion, which means I cannot exert, and my body stops digesting food.

Arousal runs on that same machinery, a controlled sympathetic-up and parasympathetic-down cycle, so it breaks down alongside them.

That cutout is the whole autonomic system rather than a gate on sex. Sex needs a working autonomic system the same way a workout or a meal does, and at minus two there is not one.

Below that there is no arousal term left to multiply, because the machinery that would produce one is offline.

title: Where The Arousal Machinery Goes Dark
